title: Prune the producerless 'clear' and 'compact' SessionStartSource variants
task:
Problem: `SessionStartSource` at packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts:61 is `'startup' | 'resume' | 'clear' | 'compact'`, but only two variants have a producer: packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts:593 publishes `'startup'` and the resume path passes its source through packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts:632-640. No plugin emits `'clear'` or `'compact'` (grep for `'compact'` and `'clear'` across packages/*/*/src finds no `agent/session-start` producer) and no test constructs them. The README bullet at packages/core/agent/README.md:121 (mirrored at packages/core/agent/README.zh.md:121) justifies the reservation with a `TODO(compaction)` marker that exists nowhere in the tree, and the compaction seam that shipped under packages/compaction shadows regions inside one session and never restarts a session, so no producer is coming. Repository rule: producer-gated variants stay out until produced (the llm README's Known Limitations cites the archived prune-producerless-vocabulary-variants note for the same rule).

Required: narrow the type to `'startup' | 'resume'` and make its JSDoc name the two producers; delete the README bullet and its Chinese counterpart in the same change, then re-record the pair with `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write packages/core/agent/README.md`; run `pnpm run doc-sync` and regenerate only the catalogs it reports stale.

Constraints: do not add a session event, do not edit packages/core/agent-loop, do not rename or widen other `SessionStartSource` consumers. This is a mechanical, local edit under the Agent Note exemption; do not add one.
